home.title: Learn in a safe place, and prove what you learned
home.lead: Web development, cybersecurity and KVKK compliance training with animated lessons, quizzes and verifiable certificates.

learn.title: Interactive lessons
learn.body: Learn step by step with video, animated modules and in-browser exercises.

prove.title: Verifiable certificates
prove.body: Every certificate is digitally signed and anyone can verify it by its certificate number.

comply.title: Compliance for teams
comply.body: Assign training to employees, follow their progress and report on KVKK compliance.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for may have moved or never existed.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is wrong, the address is not verified yet, or the account is temporarily locked. After several failed attempts it locks for 15 minutes; resetting the password opens it at once.
errors.email_not_verified: Verify your email address before signing in. Check your inbox.
errors.disposable_email: Temporary email addresses are not accepted. Use a permanent address.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalid_code: The code is not valid. Enter the current code from your app.
errors.challenge_expired: The verification step timed out. Sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session could not be confirmed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.mfa_required: Turn on two-factor authentication to enter the admin area.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.
errors.invalid_input: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.payment_required: This course is paid. Online payment opens soon; until then you can enrol in the free courses.
errors.not_found: What you are looking for could not be found.
errors.not_enrolled: This lesson is open to learners enrolled in the course.
errors.not_watched: Watch most of the video to complete the lesson.
errors.quiz_locked: The final exam opens once you have finished every lesson.
errors.invalid_link: This link is not valid. Use the QR code on the certificate.
errors.attempt_limit: You have used today’s attempts. You can try again within 24 hours.
errors.cannot_change_self: You cannot change your own account here.
errors.last_admin: The organization needs at least one active admin.
errors.not_a_company: Only company accounts can send invitations.
errors.email_taken: This address already has a Lumio account. Try signing in.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.totpLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
signIn.useApp: Use the code from the app

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lead: Start learning on your own or train your team.
signUp.personalHint: I want to learn for myself.
signUp.companyHint: I want to assign training to my employees and follow their progress.
signUp.name: Full name
signUp.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A long sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
signUp.companyNote: Whoever opens a company account becomes its admin and must turn on two-factor authentication.
signUp.marketing: Email me about new courses and offers (optional; you can change this at any time).

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. The link is valid for 24 hours.
checkEmail.note: If it does not arrive, look in your spam folder.

verify.title: Verify your email address
verify.lead: Enter the password you chose when you signed up to activate the account.
verify.notYou: Did not sign up yourself? Then someone else typed your address; sign up with your own password instead.

account.title: My account
account.setupStep1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
account.manual: If you cannot scan it, enter this key by hand:
account.setupStep2: Enter the 6-digit code your app shows.
account.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Your sessions on other devices were signed out.
account.sessionsLead: Sign out any session you do not recognise straight away.
account.recoveryHint: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only this time; keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone.

admin.title: Organization admin
admin.name: Name
admin.auditLead: The last 100 critical actions in your organization. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.

catalog.title: Course catalog
catalog.lead: Animated lessons and certified courses in web development, cybersecurity and KVKK compliance.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search for a course, topic or instructor
catalog.emptyBody: Try removing a filter or searching for a different word.

course.enrolledNote: You are enrolled. The course is in "Continue where you left off" on the home page.
course.paidNote: Online payment opens soon. You can already save the course to your wishlist.
course.notFoundBody: This course may have been unpublished, or its address may have changed.

player.videoHint: The lesson completes on its own once you have watched 90% of the video.
player.lockedTitle: This lesson is for enrolled learners
player.lockedBody: You can watch the free preview lessons without enrolling. Enrol to open every lesson.
player.preparingBody: Its content will be added soon. For now you can move on to the next lesson.
player.previewBanner: You are in a preview lesson. Enrol for every lesson and to keep your progress.
player.allDoneTitle: Well done, you have completed every lesson in this course!
player.allDoneBody: You can now take the quizzes; once you pass them all, the course is complete.
player.lessonNotFound: This lesson could not be found.

quiz.lockedBody: The final exam opens once you have completed every lesson in the course.
quiz.question: Question {{current}} of {{total}}
quiz.failedBody: You need at least {{percent}}% to pass. Review the lessons and try again.
quiz.finalHidden: On the final exam, results per question are shown once you pass. This stops the exam being passed by trying options one at a time.
quiz.courseDoneBody: You finished every lesson and passed every quiz. Your verifiable certificate will be here in the next step.
quiz.noAttempts: You have used today’s attempts. You can try again within 24 hours.

verifyPage.title: Certificate verification
verifyPage.lead: Check that a Lumio certificate is genuine by its certificate number.
verifyPage.validBody: It was digitally signed by Lumio and matches the record exactly.
verifyPage.invalidBody: The signature does not match the record. The document may have been altered or forged; do not accept it.
verifyPage.notFoundBody: Check the number. The QR code on the certificate brings you straight to the right page.
verifyPage.maskedNote: The name is partly hidden to protect personal data. The QR code on the certificate shows it in full.
verifyPage.howBody: The details on every certificate are signed with Lumio’s private key when it is issued. This page checks the signature again with the published public key; if a single letter of the document changes, the signature fails. The public keys are here:

certificates.title: My certificates
certificates.lead: Verifiable certificates for the courses you have completed.
certificates.emptyBody: When you finish every lesson of a course and pass its quizzes, your certificate appears here.

adminCerts.title: Certificates
adminCerts.lead: Certificates issued in your organization. A revoked certificate shows as revoked on the verification page; this cannot be undone.

members.inviteLead: The person receives a link that is valid for 7 days and can be used once.

invitePage.title: Welcome to Lumio
invitePage.lead: {{organization}} invited you to join their team as {{role}}.
invitePage.name: Full name
invitePage.done: Your account is ready. You can sign in now.
invitePage.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired. Ask your organization admin for a new one.

platform.title: Platform administration
platform.lead: A summary of every organization. This page shows numbers, never personal data.
platform.coursesLead: An unpublished course leaves the catalog; learners already enrolled keep their access.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If {{email}} has a Lumio account, a link to choose a new password is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Saving a new password signs you out on every device.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.

assign.title: Assign a course
assign.lead: Members are enrolled at once and get an email. Choose a due date to see who is late.
assign.freeOnly: Free courses only for now; paid ones arrive with payments.
assign.reportLead: Late ones first. Click a name to open their transcript.
assign.removeConfirm: Remove this assignment? The member keeps the course and what they have done in it.

transcript.title: Learning transcript
transcript.foot: Certificate numbers can be checked at /dogrula. This transcript lists courses taken on Lumio.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.password_changed: Your password was changed and every device was signed out. If this was not you, reset it now.
notifications.two_factor_enabled: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your account.

privacy.title: Privacy and consent
privacy.lead: Choose what we may send you, and take a copy of everything we hold about you.
privacy.marketing: Email me about new courses and offers
privacy.exportHint: A JSON file with your account, learning records, sessions and consents.
privacy.manage: Manage your consents and download your data

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.text: Lumio uses only the cookies it needs to work: your session and its security. No analytics or advertising cookies.

courseEdit.title: Edit course
courseEdit.lead: What the catalog and the course page say. Lessons, quizzes and the price stay as they are.
courseEdit.subtitle: Subtitle
courseEdit.certificate: Completing the course earns a certificate
courseEdit.note: Certificates already issued keep the title they were signed with; new ones carry the new title.
courseEdit.saved: Saved. The catalog shows the new text now.

categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: Two levels. A category can only be deleted once no course or subcategory uses it.
categories.name: Name
categories.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, e.g. cloud-security
